headline: ARC Prize reports DeepSeek Flash ARC-3 results

sections.text: ARC Prize reported that DeepSeek V4.1 Flash reached about three percent on its ARC-3 evaluation with a provider adapter, and under one percent with the standard harness.
The linked results compare low reasoning with max reasoning. This is an ARC Prize model evaluation, separate from a team submission on the public Kaggle leaderboard.
